title.zh: 将 Eulogio Rodriguez 省立纪念医院升格为医疗中心，更名为“Amang”医疗中心并拨款
title.en: An Act Upgrading the Eulogio Rodriguez, Sr. Memorial Hospital From a Provincial Hospital to a Medical Center, Renaming It as 'Amang' Rodriguez Medical Center, and Appropriating Funds Therefor

text.en: The status of the Eulogio Rodriguez, Sr. Memorial Hospital in the Municipality of Marikina, Metro Manila, is hereby upgraded from a provincial hospital to a medical center of the Department of Health. As such, the hospital shall be under the laws, rules and regulations governing the category of existing hospitals.
The amount necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act shall be included in the General Appropriations Act of the year following its enactment into law and thereafter.
The hospital as a medical center shall participate in the training of doctors in their chosen field of expertise, nurses and paramedics. The conduct of research shall also be undertaken.
Henceforth, this hospital shall be named as 'Amang' Rodriguez Medical Center.
This Act shall take effect immediately upon its approval and publication in the Official Gazette.
